responsibility: Provides shared Rust HIR-to-GCC lowering utilities that are reused across item, statement, and expression compilation. In particular it implements function declaration setup from Rust visibility, qualifiers, and attributes; emits diagnostics for attribute misuse; builds function bodies, locals, parameters, return temporaries, and constexpr wrappers for const items; and constructs named constant declarations, making it the central helper layer for turning resolved Rust HIR plus TyTy types into GCC function and constant trees.
same_name_distinction: Implements the shared lowering helpers declared in the paired header, including concrete logic for function declaration setup, attribute handling, local/block discovery, full function body construction, and constexpr-backed constant compilation. Unlike the header, it is the executable helper layer used by other compilers, not the cross-cutting API surface.
